account: Warwickshire County Council tested a locally hosted Llama 2 model to classify businesses by size and food availability, aiming to identify areas with limited access to affordable, nutritious food. Accuracy was 63%, compared with 95% for a simpler method. Processing took up to 1.5 hours per output. The council anticipated that further fine-tuning could save staff time on manual searches. Its evaluation demonstrates neither time savings nor improved food access. Inconsistent model labels leave the exact configuration unclear.

fields.account: Warwickshire County Council tested a locally hosted Llama 2 model to classify businesses by size and food availability, aiming to identify areas with limited access to affordable, nutritious food. Accuracy was 63%, compared with 95% for a simpler method. Processing took up to 1.5 hours per output. The council anticipated that further fine-tuning could save staff time on manual searches. Its evaluation demonstrates neither time savings nor improved food access. Inconsistent model labels leave the exact configuration unclear.
